items.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 9, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I’ve talked with some of the other wonderful drummers that were in the band and they were all subject to Freddie Green turning and looking at them at one point or another. And maybe with the exception of Harold Jones, I don’t know, Harold never let anything get him down

ctx.x: Wow. Man that’s like, I mean you could go to bed for the rest of your life and go what was that, Freddie?

What did I do? But I do have to admit in all honesty, and I’m not going to name names, but I’ve talked with some of the other wonderful drummers that were in the band and they were all subject to Freddie Green turning and looking at them at one point or another. And maybe with the exception of Harold Jones, I don’t know, Harold never let anything get him down, with the exception of Jonesie I think all of us are still worried about whatever the hell it was the Freddie meant, all this time, all these years, what…
Well he was like a, as you say, a constant. So did you find that he was — I’m not sure how to say this, who was the metronome in the band?
